visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Joeman stands in an airport corridor, facing the camera with an energetic smile. He wears a white shirt, glasses, and a black backpack. He holds two green Taiwanese passports. The background features vertical wooden slats and airport signs. (2) Close-up shot focusing on the back of the green passport, showing a small orange SES sticker. Joeman points at the sticker with his thumb. The lighting is bright and even. (3) Joeman is accompanied by a friend in a black jacket and white mask. They are walking through a brightly lit airport hallway with moving walkways. Passers-by are visible in the distance. (4) View of a black digital sign with ENTRY text and Korean characters. Icons showing people and temperature sensors are visible. The environment looks like a modern international terminal. (5) Joeman and another friend in a black hoodie celebrate after clearing customs. They are in a large arrivals hall with high ceilings and white pillars. Joeman gestures excitedly towards the upper floor where another person is visible. (6) A text-heavy graphic appears on screen listing SES registration locations in Korean airports. Joeman remains on the side, holding his passport near his face while speaking.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to demonstrate and compare the efficiency of the South Korean Smart Entry Service (SES) for Taiwanese travelers. Joeman shows that using SES allows for significantly faster customs clearance (under 5 minutes) compared to those without it, even when traveling during busy late-night hours. The video concludes with practical information on where to register for the service.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-paced, variety-show editing style typical of social media vlogs to make travel tips engaging. The contrast between Joeman's 'smooth' entry and his friends' slower progress provides comedic value.
